Now: past events/tasks are only closed (no delete prompt, nothing removed from the calendar), the Saturday 12:00 reminder is previewed (evet), the Saturday car inspection asks its time once, 'rapor ucreti odendi' closes the existing item, 'aksam amcamin cezalarina bakacagim' points at the existing 23:00 event and creates nothing; the clauses that cannot share one preview are announced as queued ('sirada') and asked afterwards, one at a time.
